content.prompt:
A website for people who want to learn new skills in their free time is asking readers to write reviews of an online course or app they have used. The best reviews will be published on the website. Write your review (200-250 words). In your review you should:
- say what the course or app teaches and why you chose it
- describe what was good and what was less helpful about it
- say what kind of learner would benefit most from it and whether you would recommend it
